# lmw unread

Count unread notifications, messages and invitations

### Synopsis

Count what waits for you, as the badges of LinkedIn's top bar show it (one request).
With --folders, also count unread conversations in each message folder (two more requests).

```
lmw unread [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  lmw unread
  lmw unread --folders
  lmw unread --watch 10m
```

### Options

```
      --folders          also count unread conversations by message folder
  -h, --help             help for unread
      --watch duration   keep counting every DURATION (10m, 1h) and print a line when something changes; Ctrl-C stops
```

### Options inherited from parent commands

```
  -v, --verbose   show debug logs, including every API request
```
